notes: four carriage forms; build_chain makes leaf, intermediate and root
baseline is 'chain': signer and every intermediate, root omitted, as C2PA 2.5 Section 13.5 requires
an anchor's own signature is never checked, so path validation costs two verifications with the root as anchor and one with the issuing CA as anchor
leaf-only carriage conforms only when the issuing CA is a trust anchor; the C2PA trust list lists issuing CAs as well as roots
thumbprint carriage has no specification-defined resolver
path timings are the cryptography/OpenSSL certificate checks; the manifest signature uses liboqs where available
merged from 10 independent runs (fresh processes and keys, random experiment and configuration order); median_ms is the median of per-run medians, ci95_ms a 95% bootstrap interval over runs
